<thought>The spectrum shows a clear isotopic envelope with peaks spaced ~1.003 Da (C‑13) and relative intensities following a binomial distribution, which is characteristic of carbon. No other element shows its distinctive isotopic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
